text_block_list.name: Ines's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Running with Ines-senpai is seriously 
insane! You've never done it before, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Then have you ever worked out with 
Ryan-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...On my way to training, I saw a rather 
concerning argument.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It kind of sounds like me and 
Ryan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hide for a bit and see how 
things go. If I show up now, it might just 
add fuel to the fire.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Quiet, please. Please raise your hand when 
speaking. Now then—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
The “4th Debate: Who Would Make a Better 
Big Sister, Ines-senpai or Ryan-senpai?” 
begins now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! As a member of the Ines faction, 
allow me to weigh in! It happened just a 
few days ago—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew! See, running makes you forget all 
the bad things, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A thank-you? No need, no need, I had fun 
too! Let's run together again and blow off 
some steam, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Ines-senpai's easygoing kindness 
really is on another level, isn't it~?!

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... As a member of the Ryan-senpai 
faction, let me have my say too! It 
happened back when I was doing muscle 
training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Look at your biceps. And 
listen closely... to the voice of your 
muscles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I've got your back. No matter 
what happens, I'll support you!

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a sense of security! 
Ryan-senpai's dependability is just out of 
this world!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Why you~...! In that case, I'll hit 'em 
with a surefire, one-hit-knockout 
special—!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This feels bad! With that kind of tension, 
I can't just—... I'm going in!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Fighting is bad! —No fighting!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Wait... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Debating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ines-senpai!? Ryan-senpai!? W-What on 
earth is going on here...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Listen, everyone! I understand how you all 
feel completely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I don't want you two fighting. 
After all, we're..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We're such good friends that we burst out 
in perfect sync! So, everyone else should—

text_block_list.name: Debating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa! The two of them are side by side~! 
To think I'd get to see this up close...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh~...? Weren't you two on the verge 
of fighting?"

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's just my usual! Whenever I get 
hyped up, I tend to lean right into it!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's right, whenever it comes to those 
two, I have so much to say that I end up 
talking really fast...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, that's a relief... but... 
I-it's embarrassing... in so many ways.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Learning that these meetings are held 
regularly, and that fans swoon over her 
casual gestures... It's no wonder she'd 
feel embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... ...Good grief, honestly—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: They're my cute underclassmen, after all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it? Why are you so surprised?
choice_data_list:
No, I was just thinking how unshakeable 
you are...

Um, I was just thinking you don't get 
shaken easily...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way, no way! I mean, I'm used to 
this kind of thing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As expected! You really live up to all 
your years of being a big sister!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah~. And so, as her big sister, I 
couldn't be happier♪ It really makes me 
wonder what kind of nice thing I can do 
for her!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you think would be good? 
As a return gift for these cute little 
sisters!
choice_data_list: A relaxing chat at a tea party!

...How about a handshake event or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Well, there's still a little time before 
training, so I guess I can keep you 
company~♪"

text_block_list.name: Debating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! Would you like to join too, 
Ryan-senpai? I'd be so happy if you came 
along!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll go. I'll go, but... don't 
lay the praise on... too thick, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, surrounded by the debate club 
members, the two big sisters enjoyed their 
tea.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure that's all? I could do as 
much as you want, though.

text_block_list.name: Debating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you really get it...! This is the 
best present ever! I gotta contact the 
members who couldn't make it...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, this whole group is still here...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Bring on as many as you 
want! Nothing is impossible for your big 
sis♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far more people rushed in than 
anticipated, but she powered through it 
with big sister spirit.
